name: Witch College 2
source:
The new chapter of the world of Witch College! The semester is over and the summer vacations have already started! However, before anyone could begin to have fun, Sam suddenly disappeared, leaving just a strange symbol behind! What could that mean? A powerful and ancient witch clan seems to be involved… but what are they planning? 

[From [url=https://kavorka.itch.io/witchcollege2]Itch.io[/url]]
